title: Illinois unemployment insurance basics
facts: Illinois unemployment insurance can provide partial wage replacement to eligible unemployed workers.
A claimant generally must have earned at least $1,600 during the applicable base period and at least $440 outside the highest-earning base-period quarter.
Depending on when the claim was established, regular benefits may be available for up to 26 full weeks in a one-year period.
Claimants generally must certify every two weeks to receive benefits.
